references.text: The earlier count of the sons of Merari showed 6200, and this verse gives details for the men fit for service between 30 and 50 years old from that same clan.
These verses give the complete count of the sons of Merari and confirm the number 3200 for the Levites fit for service from this clan.
Describes the duties and responsibilities of the sons of Merari in the tabernacle, which is the context for the count in verse 40.
A later count of the Levitical clans, including Merari, showing continuity in the genealogical records.
